messages.text: The quartzmill build breaks on Windows only: error TS2307 cannot find module './gen/schema'.
That file is generated. I will check the prebuild script and the gitignore.
prebuild: node scripts/gen-schema.mjs; build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json; generated output dir: ./gen
writes to path.join('gen', 'schema.ts') relative to process.cwd(); clears the folder with rm -rf gen through child_process exec
There are two problems: rm -rf does not exist in cmd.exe, and the path depends on the working directory.
Use fs.rmSync and resolve from the script's own directory. Keep the generated file name schema.ts.
edit scripts/gen-schema.mjs: fs.rmSync(outDir, { recursive: true, force: true }); outDir = new URL('../gen/', import.meta.url)
The build passes on Windows after the script change. TS2307 is gone and 212 files were built.
